edges.limitations: Much milder than the human disorder: the null mouse is viable and fertile with no overt embryonic phenotype, which the authors attribute to functional redundancy with other Scube family members. Mouse Scube3 also does not affect the hedgehog pathway, unlike zebrafish scube3, so cross-species inference about SCUBE pathway roles is unsafe.

nodes.description: Biallelic inactivating SCUBE3 variants remove a membrane-associated BMP2/4 co-receptor. Wild-type SCUBE3 attracts BMP receptor complexes to lipid-raft microdomains and enhances BMP signalling, apparently by facilitating the interaction of BMP ligands with BMP type I receptors. The disease-causing N294K missense allele reaches the cell surface normally but fails to complex with BMP type IA receptor - so the defect is in receptor engagement, not in protein trafficking.
